overall_reason: The page has one load reveal, the hero's seven .rise blocks arriving over 700 ms on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) and switched off under reduced motion; the diagram lightboxes, the theme toggle and the copy button all answer instantly; and the only sweep hit (an easing hit on a 200 ms opacity label fade) is a small paint change.

score.reason: T-PURPOSE, T-FREQUENCY and T-CHOREOGRAPHY pass (one hero reveal, instant feedback on the repeated controls), and T-MOTION-SYSTEM finds only the browser's default ease on 67 hover colour transitions.

findings.title: One curve family and one duration scale
findings.where: declared hover transitions on links, buttons and diagram cards (border-color, color, background), 1440
findings.evidence: The declared table shows 67 of 74 transitioning elements on the browser's default `ease` at 200 ms, beside one tuned curve, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) at 700 ms, used only for the hero reveal. The sweep's motion/easing hit on the "View the first-pass diagram full size" label (opacity 200 ms ease) comes from the same default.
findings.before: transition: border-color 200ms ease (browser default), on 67 elements
findings.after: A short hover token, such as 150 ms on the page's own decelerating curve or a plain ease-out, routed through one variable
findings.why: The hero reveal shows a chosen curve, but every hover answer falls back to the browser default, so the page runs two unrelated timings for small state changes.
findings.root: the site-wide 200ms ease hover transition rule

strengths: The hero arrives once: seven .rise blocks fade and rise over 700 ms on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), and the stylesheet's prefers-reduced-motion rule sets them to opacity 1 and no transform.
The diagram lightboxes ("View the redrawn diagram full size", "View the Exploded axonometric diagram full size") open with no measured movement, so repeated viewing costs no time.
The "Copy the npx skills install command" button answers within 26 ms with a "COPIED" label, and the dark and light toggle switches the theme instantly.
not_investigated: Passive motion: no passive recording, so motion that plays without a click is not verified.
The FIG. 00 demo video ("17S · NO SOUND"): the capture blocked demo-light.mp4 and demo-dark.mp4, so T-POSTER and T-DEMO-LOOP were not judged.
Interruptibility and rapid toggles (T-RAPID-TOGGLE): no detector built.

Gestures and drags; scroll-driven and scroll-revealed motion beyond the load (the capture does not scroll while recording); hover as it plays (only its declaration is read); route or page transitions.
Content left hidden when the IntersectionObserver never fires (545 characters) belongs to the sweep's hidden_content (ROB-001).
